 Starting XI: Red Bull New York vs. Inter Miami CF

 Copy URL 
 Share on Facebook

 Inter Miami CF is set to face Red Bull New York tonight at Sports Illustrated Stadium in MLS Matchday 32. Kickoff is set for 5:30 p.m. ET. Below are the starting lineups selected by both teams for tonight’s matchup.
 Inter Miami CF (4-3-3): GK Dayne St. Clair; D Gonzalo Luján, Casemiro, Micael, Sergio Reguilón; M Rodrigo De Paul, David Ayala, Matías Galarza; F Riquelme Fillipi, Luis Suárez ©, Germán Berterame
 Substitutes: GK Rocco Ríos Novo; D Ian Fray, Facundo Mura; M Telasco Segovia, Yannick Bright, Santiago Morales, Alexander Shaw; F Leo Messi, Daniel Pinter
 Head Coach: Cristian González
 Red Bull New York (4-3-3): GK Ethan Horvath; D Dylan Nealis ©, Julian Bazan, Tim Parker, Devin Padelford; M Mohammed Sofo, Adri Mehmeti, Ronald Donkor; F Cade Cowell, Julian Hall, Jorge Ruvalcaba
 Substitutes: GK John McCarthy; D Jahkeele Marshall-Rutty, Matthew Dos Santos; M Sekou Kone, David Ruiz; F Emil Forsberg, Eric Choupo-Moting, Cameron Harper, Rafael Mosquera
 Head Coach: Michael Bradley
